about: ADAI Systems taste vault. Local only: never linked from the site, never deployed. Images live in references/ and are gitignored because they are screenshots of other people's sites. Re-capture them with `node scripts/capture-references.mjs`.

items.steal: One plain sentence set huge, one flat yellow circle, and a crosshair cursor: a single loud idea with nothing competing.
Type used as the image itself, packed tight in black and white, with a quiet sidebar so the specimens can shout.
Full-width rounded tiles where a single word at display size sits on top of a texture: each project could be a tile like this.
A name so large it runs off both edges and scrolls sideways: scale as confidence, with tiny labels as counterweight.
The hero is the product doing its thing (animated ASCII in a real terminal window), then two buttons. No tagline needed.
Near-black with one green, a live terminal snippet in the corner, mono labels for everything technical: serious without being corporate.
A dot-matrix object built from glyphs, in one accent green on black: texture from characters instead of gradients.
Terminal tools sold with zero restraint: proof that developer work can be loud and still credible. Take the nerve, not the pink and violet.
Navigation as a row of tiny pictograms with micro labels, and the object lit like a museum piece on pure black.
Flat orange and yellow blocks stepping like pixels, with tiny pixel-art characters walking along the edges: an AI lab that looks hand-made.
The whole site is a little desktop with draggable windows on a flat pink ground: an interface metaphor people want to play with.
Dense, funny and unafraid of clutter: a site as an operating system, with humour in the cookie banner. Personality in every corner.
A studio that shows a room, not a pitch: dark, cinematic, with a neon wordmark and the line 'We make cool shit that performs'. Attitude in the copy.
Reads like a document: sidebar index, plain sentences, and a real data diagram as the only decoration. Substance as style.
A working canvas in the hero that you can draw on straight away: the demo is the pitch.
An illustrated night sky behind real product UI: a mood that belongs to one company only. Take the idea of a world, not the purple.
A faint blueprint grid with measured margins makes the page feel engineered. The old ADAI site already did this, so use sparingly.
Nothing to steal: cream ground, small serif italic, tiny spaced caps. Elegant here, but it is now the default look of every generated site. Kept as the thing not to make.
